title: StateHash's fixed 4096-byte buffer silently returns the empty FNV offset hash for any state serializing above 4096 bytes
detail: Verified: two states serializing to 5498 bytes with different demand hash identically to cbf29ce484222325. Replay-equality and non-vacuous-hash checks false-pass for large states; ~85 packets or ~215 pipes cross the boundary.
recommended_fix: Grow the buffer (e.g. serialize to a vector and hash it directly, or loop-doubling retry), and treat SerializeState()==0 in StateHash as an assert/latch rather than hashing zero bytes.

title: EqualCostHops indexes HopOffset out of bounds when the topology has more node slots than the stale table's N
detail: Verified with ASan: table built for N=2, one SpawnNode later (gen bumped, no rebuild), EqualCostHops(newNode, oldNode) → heap-buffer-overflow read of HopOffset[4] (size 4). The shape guard misses slot-count staleness; comment claims 'ok=false if the table is stale'.
recommended_fix: Add `R.N != T.NodeAlive.size()` (or Fs/Ds >= R.N) to the staleness guard returning false, covering HasPath/NextHop callers that hold pre-spawn tables.

title: StepScenario silently drops action-log entries beyond 16 sharing one apply_tick — live/replay diverge with no ReplayError latch
detail: Verified: 22 logged draws at tick 1 → live run has 20 pipes; StepScenario replay applies 16, drops 6, ReplayError stays 0. Silent ODN-11 replay divergence through the shared golden harness.
recommended_fix: Use a std::vector sized to the log (or assert/latch ReplayError when the 16-entry cap is exceeded) so no logged command is ever silently dropped.

title: Step only guards backward ticks — same-tick re-entry double-spawns demand and forward jumps silently skip all intermediate demand and nonce draws
detail: Verified: re-calling Step(S,5) spawns the tick-5 demand again (1→2 packets) and redraws the nonce; Step(S,100) from tick 4 yields score 0/packets 0/nonce 3004863067 vs one-by-one score 10/nonce 2381141952.
recommended_fix: Latch ReplayError (or assert) when Tick != State.Tick + 1, making the advance-by-exactly-one-tick contract explicit for every driver.

title: RoutingRebuild/BundlesRebuild index kTierCost/kTierCapacity with unvalidated uint16 PipeTier — out-of-bounds read
evidence: B.BundleCap.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(kTierCapacity[T.PipeTier[Pi]]));  [PP_Routing.h:168:] const int32_t Nd = Dist[Cur] + kTierCost[T.PipeTier[Pi]];  [PP_Routing.h:207:] const int32_t C = kTierCost[T.PipeTier[Pi]];
detail: Verified with UBSan: PipeTier[0]=400 → 'index 400 out of bounds for type const int32_t[3]' at PP_Bundles.h:103 and PP_Routing.h:168/207. Only ApplyDraw validates; a loader/deserializer writing the u16 field bypasses it.
recommended_fix: Clamp or reject tier >= TIER_COUNT at the rebuild entry (or on load), since the serialized u16 tier field is the trust boundary.

title: Dist2 signed int64 overflow for extreme-but-legal int32 node coordinates (SpawnNode does not clamp)
detail: Verified with UBSan: nodes at (INT32_MIN,INT32_MIN)/(INT32_MAX,INT32_MAX) → 'signed integer overflow: -4294967295 * -4294967295' at PP_Topology.h:155; overflow also feeds SpanBetween/ISqrt (negative input returns 0).
recommended_fix: Clamp SpawnNode coordinates to the world-tile range (kMapTilesX/Y bounds) or reject coordinate deltas whose squares cannot fit int64.

title: FlowSeedDemand/FlowSpawn never validate Src/Dst node existence — packets to missing nodes wait forever, silently riding the state hash
detail: Verified: demand dst=77 (never spawned) leaves a packet in-flight at tick 100 with WaitingTicks=96, score unaffected, ReplayError=0 — unbounded silent livelock with no TTL/cull/error.
recommended_fix: Validate demand endpoints against the topology at seed time (fail fast or drop with an error flag), or bound WaitingTicks with an explicit drop event.

title: spine-check --json hardcodes nodes=3, pipes=2, spawned=11 while PPProbe computes the same golden keys from state
detail: The two golden surfaces derive the same SCHEMA.md keys differently; a scenario change leaves the standalone literals stale, surfacing only as a confusing cross-runner mismatch instead of derived values.
recommended_fix: Print NodeCount(Topology)/PipeCount(Topology)/demand-fired counts in spine-check --json instead of literal 3/2/11, matching the PPProbe derivation.
